name: Database Flow - MySQL Connection
info:
Single MySQL database with all tables.
Install: npm install node-red-node-mysql

name: Init Tables SQL
func:
// Create tables if not exist
msg.topic = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  role VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  rfid_uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS active_sessions (
  employee_id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  rfid_uid VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  login_ts TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  source VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'rfid'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_events (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  employee_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  rfid_uid VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  ts TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  source VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'rfid',
  INDEX idx_employee (employee_id),
  INDEX idx_ts (ts)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employee_messages (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  target_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'all',
  target_value VARCHAR(255),
  priority INT DEFAULT 2,
  valid_from TIMESTAMP NULL,
  valid_to TIMESTAMP NULL,
  enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_target (target_type, target_value),
  INDEX idx_enabled (enabled)
);
`;
return msg;
